description: This file provides utility functions for creating signable messages and verifying signatures for Solana wallet authentication. It includes two main functions: create_sign_message to generate a message and nonce for the client to sign, and verify_signature as a stub for signature verification.

methods.name: dict create_sign_message(address: str, nonce: str | None = None)
methods.description: Creates a signable message for Solana wallet authentication, including a timestamp and nonce.

methods.name: bool verify_signature(signature: str, message: str, address: str)
methods.description: Stub function that verifies a signature; always returns True if inputs are non-empty.
